1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of adhesive __surrounding the filler and directly bonded to the composite fabric, wherein the adhesive is a structural adhesive applied as a discrete layer distinct from any resin matrix within the composite fabric__.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, __and wherein the adhesive layer is applied after the composite fabric is positioned on the members__.

3. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, __wherein the layer of adhesive includes a folded sheet of structural adhesive applied as a separate component from the composite fabric layers__.

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas, __and wherein the adhesive is applied as a distinct structural adhesive layer separate from the composite fabric__.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, __and wherein the offset fabric layers are bonded together by the structural adhesive layer__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base; and, a layer of structural adhesive __applied as a discrete layer__ surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, __and wherein the structural adhesive layer is applied separately from and in addition to any resin matrix within the composite patches__.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, __and wherein the structural adhesive sheet is a distinct component applied separately from the composite fabric layers__.

14. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges, __and wherein the adhesive is a structural adhesive applied as a separate layer__.

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, __wherein the channels are formed from laminated composite tape plies and the base is formed from laminated composite tape plies, and wherein the structural adhesive layer is applied as a discrete bonding layer distinct from the resin matrix of the laminated plies__.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape plies having a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a cap and a base, the cap and base each including radius areas between the web and the flanges, and the cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the I-section structure defining the radius filler zone; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and __a layer of structural adhesive applied as a discrete component__ joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone.
